name: Sino Wealth Electronic Ltd.
summary: Established in 1994 and based in Shanghai, China, Sino Wealth Electronic Ltd. operates as a comprehensive semiconductor company. It specializes in the research, design, development, production, and global sale of integrated circuits. Their product portfolio encompasses industrial control-grade microcontroller chips, advanced OLED display driver chips, and related electronic module products. Beyond its core manufacturing, the company also engages in the import, export, and wholesale of electronic products, alongside offering commission-based agency and specialized technical consulting services. These components find widespread application in various sectors, powering home and kitchen appliances, lithium battery management systems, motor control, smart meters, computer peripherals, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Their display driver solutions specifically cater to PMOLED and AMOLED technologies.
